column6: comment -- tables of 16 bit pointers; kind = data (pointers to data) or code (pointers to routines)

column1: # target_bank: bank the pointers lead into when they are >= $4000 (0 = same as the table)

column6: comment
RoomMetatileTable: metatile definitions per room theme (index = (round-1)&15; 16 = bonus)
RoomSpriteSetTable: source of the second sprite tile set in bank 2
RoomMapTable: packed 2 bit room maps (64 bytes each)
RoomVramJobTable: VRAM copy jobs per room
EnemySlotTable: addresses of the 16 enemy slots in WRAM
EnemyBehaviorTable: routine run by UpdateEnemy indexed by hEnemyKind (kinds 0-11)
SoundCommandDataTable: song or effect data start per sound id ($81-$93; $8c is an empty slot that points at padding)
SoundCommandHandlerTable entry 0 (not a routine: the value $5cba is the data of id $93)
SoundCommandHandlerTable entries for ids $81-$92 (the entry for $93 overlaps the priority table at $4141 and stays raw): the routine that starts each id (music type $4263; effect type $4292)
RoundDataTable: data per round (index wRound-1)
BonusSelectJobTable: VRAM job lists indexed by $c43b
CreditsPageTable: VRAM job lists for the staff credits pages
SmallPointerTable3D6A
PointerTable3F4C: first word is not a pointer
RoomNameJobTable: VRAM job list (room name) per room index
MagicCardTitleJobs: VRAM job per card id (card name strip)
MagicCardPictureJobs: VRAM job per card id (card picture)
MagicCardCostJobs: VRAM job per card id (MP cost label)
MagicEffectTable: routine that applies each card (index = card id)
jump table of three entry points (the code after it starts at $2541)
